multi_instrument_consensus_phase4.rule: Rossi+2026 S4.1 - take ALL instruments, fold the spread into the error, never pick a favourite.
multi_instrument_consensus_phase4.durations_are_CONSISTENT: T90 143.7 s (GBM 50-300 keV) / 65.7 s (BAT 15-350 keV) / 46 s (WAM 100-1000 keV) is the expected band ordering (Qin+2013 Tbar90 ~ E^-0.20) plus threshold differences; BAT's own LC returns to baseline only at ~T+170 s.
multi_instrument_consensus_phase4.Ep_is_NOT_a_measurement_on_this_burst: published values span 69.9, 101.6, 155, 207, 209.95, 247.5(rest), 335(rest), 396, 411(rest), 1480, 2387, 2438.8, 5390(rest) keV. Three independent instruments over three bands all measure a POWER LAW of photon index ~1.6 with no required curvature: BAT 1.59 +/- 0.14 (15-150 keV), WAM 1.61 +0.08 -0.07 (100-1000 keV), GBM flnc_plaw 1.4568 +/- 0.0119 (10-1000 keV). Every quoted Ep is therefore a model artefact of where a break was placed in a featureless spectrum.
multi_instrument_consensus_phase4.consequence: any Amati/Yonetoku placement of bn130215063 must carry an inter-instrument+inter-model systematic that DOMINATES the statistical error. Cano+2014 Fig. 12 already places it as the only one of their trio that is merely 'within the 2-sigma confidence interval'.
